Skin studio for Mario Kart Wii characters. You need your own copy of the game (ISO, WBFS, RVZ or WIA). No game files are included.

## Install

**Windows:** run `MKSkinStudio-VERSION-Windows-x64-setup.exe`. The installer is not code signed yet, so if SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info** and then **Run anyway**. `.mkss` projects open with a double click.

**macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel): open the `.dmg` and drag **MK Skin Studio** to **Applications**. The app is not signed or notarized yet, so macOS blocks the first launch:
1. Right-click **MK Skin Studio** in Applications and choose **Open**, or
2. try to open it once, then go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
3. If macOS says the app "is damaged", run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/MK Skin Studio.app"` in Terminal.

**Linux:** make the AppImage executable (`chmod +x MKSkinStudio-*-Linux-x86_64.AppImage`) and run it, or install the deb with `sudo apt install ./MKSkinStudio-*-Linux-amd64.deb`. Requires WebKitGTK 4.1 (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 38+).

Not affiliated with Nintendo.
